summary: 57-year-old out-of-state man hiking Chautauqua Trail with family collapsed and stopped breathing; bystanders started CPR, rescuers and paramedics took over; carried to trailhead and transported to hospital.
notes: BCSO case #22-04406. Release text misstates the weekday as Monday; 2022-09-04 was a Sunday (release published Mon 2022-09-05). Inserted run 1014 (BCSO chunk).
